units.text: The caret ‘⟦0⟧’ and the dollar sign ‘⟦1⟧’ are special characters that respectively match the empty string at the beginning and end of a line. They are termed ⟦2⟧anchors⟦3⟧, since they force the match to be “anchored” to beginning or end of a line, respectively.
units.sourceHTML: The caret ‘^’ and the dollar sign ‘$’ are special characters that respectively match the empty string at the beginning and end of a line. They are termed anchors, since they force the match to be “anchored” to beginning or end of a line, respectively.
